Message.Name: Simple Series Update
Message.Description: This is the message format that will be used to disseminate all Option series traded on MIAX for the current session on the cloud associated for this connection.

Field.Name: Product Add/Update Time
Field.Description: Time at which this product is added/updated on Emerald system today.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Emerald Product ID mapped to a given option. It is assigned per trading session and is valid for that session.

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol for the option.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Option Security Symbol

Field.Name: Expiration Date
Field.Description: Expiration date of the option in YYYYMMDD format

Field.Name: Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price of the option. Refer to data types for field processing notes

Field.Name: Call or Put
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Opening Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 09:30:00

Field.Name: Closing Time
Field.Description: Expressed in HH:MM:SS format. Eg: 16:15:00

Field.Name: Restricted Option
Field.Description: Restricted Option

Field.Name: Long Term Option
Field.Description: Long Term Option

Field.Name: Active on Emerald
Field.Description: Indicates if this symbol is tradable on Emerald in the current session

Field.Name: Emerald BBO Posting Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation as agreed to by the Options industry (penny pilot program) and as published by Emerald

Field.Name: Quote Acceptance Increment Indicator
Field.Description: This is the Minimum Price Variation for Quote acceptance as per Emerald rules

Field.Name: Opening Underlying Market Code
Field.Description: Options opening will be triggered on receipt of Opening quote/trade from this Underlying market

Field.Name: Priority Quote Width
Field.Description: Maximum allowable width for a quote for this Option during regular trading in order to be considered as Priority Quote. 0 when Priority Quote Width is not applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: ** Reserved for future use **

Message.Name: Simple ARM Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable Optional: If this is filled with spaces, this ARM protection setting will be used as a default setting for this MPID.

Field.Name: Allowable Engagement Percentage
Field.Description: Percentage of quote size at which the Market Maker wants Emerald to trigger ARM protection for this underlying. Please refer to the rules for details of ARM. Maximum value is 65,535 (65,535%). See note below on minimum value.

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) in which Engagement percentage is calculated in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying. Allowable Range: 100 to 15,000 milliseconds Must be a multiple of 100 milliseconds.

Message.Name: Simple ARM Settings Update Response
Message.Description: MIAX uses this format to respond to the firm with a status of their ARM protection settings request.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying sent in the request. Firms can use this to know which underlying setting did not take into effect in case of an error.

Field.Name: ARM Settings Update Status
Field.Description: ARM Settings Update Status

Message.Name: ARM2 Underlying Level Protection Settings Update Request
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to set up their ARM2 Underlying Level protection settings for each session. Changes to these settings can be made throughout the day.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Action
Field.Description: Action

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM2 protection is applicable

Field.Name: ARM Threshold Count
Field.Description: Number of ARM triggers for the Counting Period for the specified underlying that will trigger ARM2 Underlying level protection. Minimum: 3 Maximum: 99

Field.Name: Counting Period
Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) for which ARM triggers are counted in order to determine if they don’t exceed the specified ARM2 Threshold. Allowable Range: 1000 to 24,300,000 milliseconds Must be a multiple of 1,000 milliseconds.

Message.Name: ARM2 Underlying Level Protection Settings Update Response

Field.Name: Client Message ID

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying sent in the request. Firms can use this to know which underlying setting did not take into effect in case of an error.

Field.Name: ARM Settings Update Status
Field.Description: ARM Settings Update Status

Message.Name: Valid Quote Width for Opening
Message.Description: This message format will be used to convey to the firms the Valid Quote Width settings applicable to the Opening process of Emerald Options market. Each message describes a row of the Valid Quote Width table with a low end of the applicable price range and corresponding maximum quote width. The high end of the applicable price range is up to, but not including the next row’s low end applicable price range if provided or infinity for the last row. If the table has to be reloaded, all rows will be resent. Refer to Appendix C: Messaging for Valid Quote Width for Opening for an example.

Field.Name: Notification Time
Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Name: MPV Class
Field.Description: This valid width record is applicable for Options in this MPV class

Field.Name: Low End of Applicable Range
Field.Description: Low end of the price range for which this valid width is applicable. The high end of the price range is up to, but not including the low end of next row or infinity for last row.

Field.Name: Maximum Quote Width
Field.Description: Quote width applicable for this range for Options that are not Long Term Options.

Field.Name: Long Term Option Multiplier
Field.Description: Multiplier of the maximum quote width (specified in the previous field) for this range applicable for Long Term Options.

Message.Name: Simple Bulk Quote Message
Message.Description: Firms can use this message format to send up to 50 single-sided quotes. Single sided quotes enables the firms to prioritize the update of more important quotes and sides ahead of other quotes.

Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID

Field.Name: Client Send Time
Field.Description: Firm’s send time for the Quotes. Nanoseconds since Epoch.

Field.Name: Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes in this bulk quote message.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: * Reserved for future use. *

Field.Name: Single Side Quote
Field.Description: 1 to 50 single-side quotes

Message.Name: Simple Bulk Quote Response

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Bulk Quote Status
Field.Description: Bulk Quote Status

Field.Name: Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes that were submitted in the Bulk quote block

Field.Name: Invalid Quote Count
Field.Description: Number of quotes that were rejected (quotes with a status other than “ “)

Field.Name: Quote Ack Time
Field.Description: Time at which Emerald engine generated this response.

Field.Name: Single Side Quote Response
Field.Description: 1 to 50 single-side quote responses

Message.Name: Simple Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Message
Message.Description: This is the format for an eQuote message that can be sent either to match with orders and quotes on the Emerald book or when responding to a liquidity seeking event.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker This cannot be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: Client Send Time
Field.Description: Firm’s send time for the eQuote. Nanoseconds since Epoch.

Field.Name: Product ID
Field.Description: Product ID mapped to a given option assigned by Emerald for the current session This cannot be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: eQuote Action
Field.Description: eQuote Action

Field.Name: eQuote Type
Field.Description: Type of eQuote

Field.Name: Event ID
Field.Description: When eQuote Type = “O” or “P”: - Event ID must be zero. Otherwise, eQuote will be rejected. When eQuote Type = “A”: - For Opening event, Event ID must be zero. Otherwise, eQuote will be rejected. - For other Auction/Timer events, Event ID must match the Event ID of the event in progress (Emerald Event ID that was published in the Liquidity seeking event notification) When eQuote Type = “I”, or “S”: Emerald will ignore Event ID. Firms can send an Event ID of zero. This can be changed in a replacement eQuote.

Field.Name: Target Message ID
Field.Description: Zero if this is a new request. Otherwise, Client Message ID of the pending eQuote that is being replaced.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Price up to which the Market Maker is willing to match. Max Price: Defined in Technical Circular This can be changed in a replacement eQuote. This is ignored for eQuote cancels.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Max Size: 999,999 This can be changed in a replacement eQuote. Not applicable for eQuote cancel because eQuote cancel request will result in entire remaining size to be canceled.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of this eQuote

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: * Reserved for future use. *

Message.Name: Simple Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Response
Message.Description: This message indicates if the eQuote was accepted or rejected. Note that this message does not report executions. For executions, please refer to the Execution notification. For the unexecuted part that gets canceled, please refer to the Cancel notification.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: eQuote ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID for eQuote if accepted; Zero if eQuote was rejected. Replaced eQuote will have the same eQuote ID as original.

Field.Name: eQuote Request Status
Field.Description: eQuote Request Status

Message.Name: Complex Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Message
Message.Description: This is the format for a Complex eQuote message that can be sent either to match with complex book or when responding to a complex auction liquidity seeking event.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID assigned by the firm for this request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: Client Send Time
Field.Description: Firm’s send time for the Complex eQuote. Nanoseconds since Epoch.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Emerald Strategy ID is assigned per trading day and is valid only for that day. ID is not unique between Series Product ID.

Field.Name: eQuote Action
Field.Description: eQuote Action

Field.Name: eQuote Type
Field.Description: Type of complex eQuote

Field.Name: Complex Event ID
Field.Description: When complex eQuote Type = “A”: For Auction events, Event ID must match the Event ID of the event in progress (Emerald Event ID that was published in the Complex Liquidity seeking event notification) When complex eQuote Type is other than “A”: Emerald will ignore Event ID. Firms can send an Event ID of zero.

Field.Name: Target Message ID
Field.Description: Zero if this is a new request. Otherwise, Client Message ID of the pending eQuote that is being replaced.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: The net limit price for the strategy If Side is “B”: • Positive number represents net debit • Negative number represents net credit If Side is “A”: • Positive number represents net credit • Negative number represents a net debit Price of zero is net neutral transaction for either side.

Field.Name: Size
Field.Description: Number of times to execute the specified strategy. NOTE: Highest Leg Ratio of the strategy (its absolute value) multiplied by complex eQuote size must be less than or equal to 999,999

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of this complex eQuote

Field.Name: Stock Sell Short Indicator
Field.Description: Sell Short indicator if this complex eQuote sells the stock leg of the strategy

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Complex Enhanced Quote (eQuote) Response
Message.Description: This message indicates if the complex eQuote was accepted or rejected. Note that this message does not report executions. For executions, please refer to the Execution notification. For the handling of any unexecuted portion that was canceled, please refer to the Cancel notification.

Field.Name: Client Message ID
Field.Description: Unique message ID sent by the firm in the request

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID of the Market Maker

Field.Name: eQuote ID
Field.Description: Emerald assigned ID for complex eQuote if accepted; Zero if eQuote was rejected.

Field.Name: eQuote Request Status
Field.Description: eQuote Request Status

Message.Name: Quote Width Relief Notification
Message.Description: This message format will be used to notify the firms if and when Emerald grants relief to the valid quote width parameters for Opening as specified in the rules and regulatory circulars of MIAX Options market.

Field.Description: Time at which this was generated by Emerald system.

Field.Description: If filled with valid underlying, relief applies to all options symbols of this underlying. If filled with spaces, relief is an exchange-wide relief

Field.Name: Relief Multiplier
Field.Description: Relief is the multiplier times the regular acceptable quote width. Eg: For a series with quote width of $0.25, a relief multiplier of 2 implies that the acceptable quote width is $0.50.

Field.Description: Underlying symbol for which this ARM protection is applicable If this is filled with spaces and MPID is filled with valid MPID, this ARM protection setting acts as the global default setting for this MPID. Note that the underlying ARM setting will override the global setting.

Field.Description: Duration (in number of milliseconds) for which trades are considered for Engagement percentage calculation in order to determine if the MPID should be put on ARM protection for this underlying.
